nom: The Crème Shop Cinnamoroll Blemish Patches

avis.texte: I got these mostly because I adore Cinnamoroll but I've found that they're actually really effective.

avis.titre: Worked beautifully, but some are too small.
avis.texte: I absolutely love the crème shops pimple patches. I think they work very well on my stubborn pimples. Idk why the other reviewer said they didn't work cause they do in fact work very well. My only complaint is that there a few that were too small, the birds.
I been trying all the pimple patches from the Sanrio collection and this is the worst. Is basically incredibly small AND does not work at all.
